mechanism: NQ=F overnight 18:00 ET -> 10:00 ET change predicts equity returns after the 10:31 decision; this is a NEW decision time, the old 9:30 strategy is invalid

preregistered.signal: nq_overnight = PRIOR CALENDAR day 18:00 bar open -> current day 09:00 bar close (bar ends 10:00); Monday uses Sunday, missing window -> per-day needs_data
preregistered.declared_decision_at: 10:31 ET (execution proxy = predeclared historical 10:30 close, NOT verified real fills)
preregistered.direction: fixed; NQ sign is descriptive only; economics long-only SOXL/SOXX/cash, no short portfolio
preregistered.primary_label: session_close chosen by official Futu receipt (WHOLE->16:00, MORNING->13:00)
preregistered.auxiliary_label: 13:00 close (descriptive only, not selected among horizons)
preregistered.next_open: strictly-next trading day 09:45 open, exit_at > decision_at
preregistered.economics: cash->target at 10:30, target->cash at session close; exact fee_affordable_target+settle_target_session two-leg; both costs
preregistered.uncertainty: fixed 20-session moving blocks over the FULL official calendar; invalid days kept as a mask and filtered inside the statistic
preregistered.primary_target: SOXL-SOXX spread IC; individual ICs descriptive only
preregistered.benchmark: real SOXX continuous open->next-open buy-hold account (independent of 10:30 entry)

futures_roll: NQ=F Yahoo front continuous; roll/adjustment listed separately, not independent evidence
no_reuse: original night-session +0.22 result is void and not reused
stop_rule: no fee-robust positive edge at 25bp -> end_route_no_further_search; no tuning on ~2 years of seen data
